title: Chat console
summary: Optional chat and command UI independent of flight state.

blocks.text: Provides ui.chat@1.0.0 for browser/offline. Create with explicit root and viewport DOM, a submit callback and optional visibility/window interaction ports. Session adapters echo chat in shared order; game command modules interpret slash commands. The console does not own simulation or network state.

The module owns its template, styles, input handlers, window layout, observers and minimized/layout preferences. Disposing a console/provider removes handlers, observers, resize controls and DOM. Removing chat does not remove session gameplay. No mandatory flight actions, HUD, renderer or theme dependencies.
Use the same editable .spacemod build/import consent and compatible replacement flow as other modules. Layout preferences are local and are not in authoritative saves or identity.
